ruling: DERIVE-3 brief as reshaped by the operator and scope-reviewer ruling under ADR-053 (coordinator, 2026-10-25): bind the captures of the instruments' own pages to their items, then read the items so the pinpoints the statutory schedule cites become obligation objects joined to the schedule; the steps fetch nothing, so no scrape cadence is exercised (rule 16 stands) and no step carries a cadence_exception (the plan validator refuses the key on a step that fetches nothing)
